# Brian Kibet — AI Trainer & LLM Evaluation Specialist

> AI Trainer & LLM Evaluation Specialist with expertise in RLHF, SFT, Prompt Engineering, and Model Quality.

## About

Brian Kibet is an AI Trainer and LLM Evaluation Specialist with 3+ years of remote experience in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), supervised fine-tuning data creation, pairwise preference ranking, rubric-based scoring, and multimodal quality assessment.
